description: This file defines the OneToOneRelationship class, which manages metadata for one-to-one relationships within the SuiteCRM project. It extends an abstract relationship class and provides methods for building relationship metadata, vardefs, and layout fields for such relationships.

classes.name: OneToOneRelationship
classes.description: A class that manages metadata for one-to-one relationships in SuiteCRM, providing methods to build relationship metadata and vardefs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OneToOneRelationship instance with a provided definition, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: buildRelationshipMetaData
methods.description: Builds and returns an array containing the relationship metadata definition for the left-hand side module.

methods.name: buildVardefs
methods.description: Constructs vardefinitions for link and relate fields for the modules involved in the relationship.

methods.name: buildFieldsToLayouts
methods.description: Determines which fields should be added to module layouts based on the relationship's characteristics.
